content.short: StealthEX is a non-custodial instant crypto exchange supporting 1500+ assets for cross-chain swaps with no registration or KYC required.
content.description: StealthEX is a non-custodial instant exchange that enables users to swap between over 1,500 cryptocurrencies without creating an account or completing KYC verification, aggregating rates from multiple liquidity providers to offer competitive cross-chain exchange rates. The platform supports assets on Mantle and provides a privacy-respecting alternative to centralized exchanges for users who value simplicity and self-custody. StealthEX has processed millions of swaps since its founding and is a trusted non-KYC swap service.
content.meta: StealthEX is a custody-free instant crypto exchange for 1500+ assets with no registration on Mantle. Discover StealthEX on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
